chapter_title_en: Winds Stir Beyond the Seas: The Challenge (Part 2)
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 375: The One-Strike Win and the Spirit Mountain
chapter_meta_description: Han Li ends the Star Palace challenge in a single, unreadable attack, forcing mass forfeits. He secures a trade token, delivers a cold warning, and glimpses the island’s towering Spirit Mountain.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 375: The Challenge Ends in One Blow
og_description: Han Li’s tactical patience pays off in a single, invisible strike. All challengers forfeit. A jade slip changes hands, and a new island bureaucracy awaits.
twitter_title: RMJI 375: One move. Zero damage. Total forfeit.
twitter_description: Han Li ends the Star Palace challenge with a blink-and-you-miss-it knockout, collects the prize, and rides off to meet a mountain.

lore_anchors.definition: The administrative gate on Kuixing Island where cultivators register for permanent residence and receive their cultivation site assignments.
The governing authority of the Heaven Star and Sea Star Islands, which oversees tournaments, trade rights, and island regulations.
An organized body of cultivators tasked with protecting certain Star Palace assets; previously unknown to Han Li.
The immense, cloud-piercing mountain range at the center of Kuixing Island, site of the Ascending Immortal Pavilion and home to countless peaks for cultivator dwellings.
